wikidata.purpose: Provide structured facts (founding date, population, architect, etc.), description, Wikipedia link, and lead image for place details
wikidata.dataSent: Wikidata entity ID (QID from OSM tag), language preference
wikidata.dataReceived: Entity claims, descriptions, Wikipedia sitelinks, referenced entity labels

wikimedia-commons.purpose: Fetch metadata for the Wikidata main image (P18 claim)
wikimedia-commons.dataReceived: Thumbnail URL, artist, license, capture date, coordinates

wikipedia.purpose: Show the Wikipedia extract linked by the Wikidata entity
wikipedia.dataSent: Article title from the selected Wikidata sitelink, language code
